NEW BRAND

NEW BRAND has a number of significant advantages when it comes to scaling our business, which will help us to better market our services globally.

 

We understand that successful expansion requires solid pillars and multi-faceted support, and we have invested significant resources and efforts in these areas.

Why Choose Us?
Experienced production line
We have an experienced production line with a comprehensive understanding of the production process to ensure high quality products. And proficient in optimizing the production process, reduce waste, improve efficiency. Our extensive production experience allows us to quickly identify and resolve any issues that may arise during the manufacturing process, minimizing disruptions and ensuring smooth operation.
After-sale processing capability
Our after-sales processing capabilities ensure that our customers' satisfaction is a priority. We have a dedicated team to deal with any questions or concerns customers may have after purchasing our products or services. This includes addressing any product defects, offering replacements or refunds, and providing support and assistance. And can quickly and effectively solve any problems that may arise after purchase.

Large And Experienced Technical Team

Our technical team consists of highly skilled professionals with extensive knowledge and expertise in the field of building materials. With many years of experience working on container housing projects, he has the ability to effectively handle complex technical challenges. And it can quickly identify problems, analyze problems, and propose effective solutions.


With our experienced technical team, you can expect an efficient and timely completion of your project when working with us. They are familiar with industry best practices and are able to streamline processes to ensure smooth project execution. Their efficiency helps save time and resources. And our team members are adaptable and can quickly adapt to changing project needs or technologies.


Our technical team is committed to delivering high quality work. They follow a rigorous quality assurance process and conduct thorough testing to ensure that the final product meets the highest standards. Their attention to detail helps provide reliable and error-free solutions.


Overall, choosing us means having a dedicated and experienced technical team that can handle your project efficiently, deliver innovative solutions, and deliver high quality results.

Enterprise certificate

Our container houses have passed the inspection and certification of most countries in the world, and the export experience is rich, can help customers solve the trouble of import ensuring that they meet the necessary safety and quality standards. These certifications include but are not limited to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, CE, UL, and CSA.


We work closely with independent testing agencies to conduct rigorous tests on our container houses, including structural integrity, fire resistance, insulation, and electrical safety. This ensures that our container houses are durable, secure, and suitable for various climates and environments. Additionally, our container houses are designed to be eco-friendly, using sustainable materials and energy-efficient systems.

Cooperate With Us

We believe that by working together, we can build a mutually beneficial partnership. As a designer, architect, contractor, trader or engineering consultancy, your expertise and skills can greatly contribute to our projects. Together we can design and build showrooms or display walls to present our products and services in the best possible way.


In addition, we can collaborate on a variety of projects, using your knowledge and experience to bring innovative and high-quality solutions to our customers. Whether it's a commercial building, a residential complex, or any other construction project, your involvement can add tremendous value.


Participating in exhibitions and trade shows is another way for us to work together. By participating in these events together, we can increase our brand awareness, connect with potential customers and partners, and keep abreast of the latest industry trends.


Overall, there are many opportunities for collaboration and we are willing to explore different areas according to your expertise and interests. Let us join hands to build a successful partnership that benefits both sides.
